title: RUBATO: Decoupled Clocks Allow Full-Duplex Models to Think as Fast as They Can
abstract: arXiv:2610.14299v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent Speech Full-Duplex (FDX) models are capable of engaging in naturalistic conversation by listening and speaking at the same time. Building on this foundation, recent architectures introduce internal thinking streams to enhance their intelligence. To guarantee these streams process successfully in real time, existing methods enforce a fixed decoding rate, which assumes a hardware profile capable of a specific latency. We argue this static approach is severely suboptimal. Because internal thinking is intrinsically asynchronous, an ideal FDX model should sustain real-time conversational flow while allowing each stream to decode at its own hardware-adaptive rate. Thinking streams must process as fast as the hardware allows to deliver accurate answers faster. translated_title: RUBATO：解耦时钟让全双工模型以硬件允许的最快速度思考
translated_abstract: 近期的语音全双工（FDX）模型能够通过同时聆听和说话来进行自然的对话。在此基础上，最新的架构引入了内部思考流以增强模型的智能。为了保证这些流能够实时成功地处理，现有方法强制执行固定的解码速率，这依赖于硬件具备特定的延迟性能。我们认为这种静态方法是严重次优的。由于内部思考本质上是异步的，一个理想的FDX模型应该在维持实时对话流程的同时，允许每个流以自身硬件自适应的速率进行解码。思考流必须以硬件所允许的速度尽可能快地处理，从而更快地给出准确的答案。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了RUBATO，一种新颖的多流位置编码方法，它为各流分配独立的时钟，从而完全解耦各个流。这种结构上的隔离使得……
tldr: RUBATO提出了一种为各流分配独立时钟的多流位置编码方法，通过完全解耦各流，使全双工语音模型的思考流能够以硬件自适应的速率异步解码，从而更快地给出准确答案。
en_tdlr: RUBATO introduces a novel multistream positional encoding that assigns independent clocks to fully decouple streams, enabling full-duplex speech models' thinking streams to decode at hardware-adaptive rates and deliver accurate answers faster.
